title: ‘सातौँ ऋतु’ उपन्यासमा अग्रभूमिनिर्माण {Foreground construction in the novel 'Seventh Season'}
nepali: यो लेख ध्रुवचन्द्र गौतमद्वारा लिखित ‘सातौँ ऋतु’ उपन्यास अन्तर्गत अग्रभूमि निर्माणको विश्लेषणमा आधारित छ । अग्रभूमि निर्माणका प्रमुख उपकरण समानान्तरता र विचलनको परिचय दिई सातौँ ऋतु उपन्यासमा रहेका समानान्तरता र विचलनको विश्लेषण गर्नु यस लेखको प्रमुख उद्देश्य हो । पुस्तकालयीय अध्ययन प्रक्रियाबाट तथ्य सङ्कलन गरी सातौँ ऋतु उपन्यासलाई प्राथमिक स्रोत तथा सैद्धान्तिक पुस्तकहरूलाई द्वितीयक स्रोतका रूपमा लिइएको यस लेखमा वर्णनात्मक विधिको उपयोग गरिएको छ । विश्लेष्य उपन्यासमा मानक व्याकरणका मान्यतामा सीमित नबनी साहित्यिक कृतिलाई कलात्मक र सार्थक तुल्याउन शैलीविज्ञानमा स्थापित अग्रभूमि निर्माणका उपकरणको यथोचित उपयोग भएको पाइयो । कृतिगत उद्धरणको विश्लेषणपछि भाषिक एकाइहरूको पुनरावृत्तिमूलक प्रयोग र विचलनयुक्त भाषाले सो उपन्यासको प्रस्तुतिलाई प्रभावकारी बनाएका छन् भने अभिव्यक्ति पनि पात्रानुकूल रहेको देखिएको छ । विचलनयुक्त प्रयोगमा आधिक्य रहेको विश्लेष्य उपन्यास विचलनका कारणले थप कलात्मक बनेको छ । साहित्यको समालोचनामा अग्रभूमिनिर्माणको यो विश्लेषण एउटा नवीन आयाम हुन सक्ने अपेक्षा गरिएको छ ।
american_english: This article is based on the analysis of foregrounding in the novel Sātau~ Ritu (Seventh Season) written by Dhruba Chandra Gautam. The main objective of this article is to introduce parallelism and deviation as the primary devices of foregrounding and to analyze the parallelism and deviation present in the novel Sātau~ Ritu. Gathering data through a library research procedure, treating the novel Sātau~ Ritu as the primary source and theoretical books as secondary sources, a descriptive method is employed in this article. In the novel under analysis, it was found that rather than being confined to the conventions of standard grammar, the foregrounding devices established in stylistics were properly utilized to make the literary work artistic and meaningful. Following the analysis of citations from the work, the repetitive use of linguistic units and deviant language have rendered the presentation of the novel effective, while the expressions are also seen to be suited to the characters. The novel under analysis, which features a predominance of deviant usage, has become all the more artistic on account of deviation. It is anticipated that this analysis of foregrounding may represent a novel dimension in literary criticism.

informal_english: This paper is based on the analysis of foregrounding in the novel Sātau~ Ritu (Seventh Season) written by Dhruba Chandra Gautam. The main goal here is to introduce parallelism and deviation as the primary tools of foregrounding and to analyse the parallelism and deviation found in the novel Sātau~ Ritu. Gathering facts through a proper library research process, taking the novel Sātau~ Ritu as the primary source and theoretical books as secondary sources, a descriptive method is used in this paper. In the novel under analysis, it turns out that rather than sticking narrowly to standard grammar rules, the foregrounding devices established in stylistics were properly used to make the literary work artistic and meaningful. Following the analysis of citations from the work, the repetitive use of linguistic units and deviant language have made the presentation of the novel effective, whilst the expressions are also seen to suit the characters down to the ground. The novel under analysis, which has heaps of deviant usage, has become all the more artistic on account of deviation. Fingers crossed, this analysis of foregrounding might represent a fresh angle in literary criticism.
